task: Runtime resource leak hardening for desktop CLI supervisor and monitor UI
runtime_context: CLI session store and bounded output buffers
Workspace Monitor snapshot fetch and async refresh effects

resource_risks.description: Finished CLI sessions can retain bounded stdout/stderr output buffers and child/thread metadata in the session store during long app use.
resource_risks.mitigation: Finished sessions now record finished_at and cleanup_finished_sessions_locked removes old finished sessions after 30 minutes or when retained finished sessions exceed 40.

resource_risks.description: Killing a child process without wait can leave process resources unreaped.
resource_risks.mitigation: kill_and_wait_child centralizes kill plus wait for session cancel/timeout/error paths; run_bounded_command try_wait error path now waits after kill.

resource_risks.description: Reader thread handles can remain attached to completed session metadata if finished sessions are never removed.
resource_risks.mitigation: Finished session cleanup joins stdout/stderr reader handles when joinable before removing the session from the store.

resource_risks.description: The snapshot fetch can continue after SnapshotLoader unmounts.
resource_risks.mitigation: SnapshotLoader now creates an AbortController and aborts the fetch in effect cleanup.

resource_risks.description: The Desktop runtime panel initial async refresh can resolve after unmount and attempt state updates.
resource_risks.mitigation: DesktopRuntimePanel now tracks mounted state and skips refresh state updates after unmount.

resource_risks.description: Active session polling can leak timers if effect cleanup does not clear the interval.
resource_risks.mitigation: Existing active session effect cleanup clears the interval and keeps an overlap guard for in-flight polls.

lifecycle_checks.create_path: create_cli_session spawns allowlisted CLI child process
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: cancel/timeout/error paths call kill_and_wait_child; bounded command error path kills and waits

lifecycle_checks.resource: CLI session output buffers and reader thread handles
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: cleanup_finished_sessions_locked removes old/excess finished sessions and joins finished reader handles
effect cleanup sets canceled and aborts the AbortController
effect cleanup sets disposed and clears interval

measurement_checks.metric: React lifecycle code compiles and builds
measurement_checks.tool: npm --prefix workspace-monitor run check && npm --prefix workspace-monitor run build

measurement_checks.threshold: largest initial chunk below configured budget
not required for this scoped source hardening slice
measurement_checks.rationale: This change adds lifecycle cleanup and compile/build validation. A long-running installed-app soak profile should be added when CLI sessions are exercised against real installed adapters.

notes: No new external dependency was added.
The standard platform-desktop-app check initially failed when developer snapshots were present; the intended monitor:build customer bundle path passed and the subsequent platform check passed.
